Comes with the original packaging and box. This was a limited edition acid etch finish as far as we can tell. The serial number shows it's #44. Tone Hungry Effects are handmade in Alberta, Canada. From Tone Hungry Effects The Hot Molasses is a great new overdrive from Tone Hungry Effects. The Hot Molasses is easy to use and very compact. On top of that, it’s a high quality build using premium resistors and capacitors – it sounds great and is extremely affordable. The Hot Molasses is built to offer the sound of a small combo amp that is driven to it’s limits. The sound has been described as the “perfect blend of fuzz and overdrive.” It cleans up beautifully with your guitars volume knob – just like an amp would.
